- #1 **The in-container browser survives a Docker update again** (issue #13). With `JD_ENABLE_BROWSER=true`, the captcha browser opener (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile) could stop working after an image update with `Unsupported OpenBrowser`, while an uninstall plus reinstall fixed it. The cause was a start-up race: the browser environment was written at runtime by an init step that has no ordering dependency on the service which launches the JDownloader JVM, so on some boots the JVM started before that write landed. The browser variables are now re-exported in the launcher itself (the JVM's direct parent), so they are always inherited regardless of boot timing. The opt-in is also persisted in `/config` so it survives a container recreate.
- #2 **New `JD_UI_SCALE` for crisp text on high-resolution displays.** On a streamed Selkies desktop, zooming the browser upscales the whole video stream and blurs the text. Set `JD_UI_SCALE` (for example `1.5` or `2`) to render the entire JDownloader UI larger at full pixel density instead, so text stays sharp at the desktop's native resolution with the browser at 100%. Empty keeps the native 1x. Opt-in, off by default.
- #3 **Packaging relicensed to AGPL-3.0.** This wrapper repository (Dockerfile, rootfs, scripts, Unraid template, README and artwork) is now under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. JDownloader itself keeps its own separate license.
- #4 **README housekeeping.** Support is now the final section with a centered support button.
